subject: general
question: Which Indian city is most influenced by retreating monsoon rainfall?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chennai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Chennai, located on the southeastern coast of India, receives significant rainfall during the **retreating monsoon** season (October to December).
 
• The retreating monsoon (also known as the Northeast Monsoon) is characterized by winds blowing from the **northeast direction**, bringing rainfall to Tamil Nadu and adjoining areas.
 
• Unlike most parts of India, which receive rainfall during the Southwest Monsoon (June to September), Tamil Nadu, particularly Chennai, relies heavily on the retreating monsoon for its annual rainfall.
 
• Chennai experiences cyclonic activity in the Bay of Bengal during this period, contributing to **intense and sudden rainfall events**.
 
• Nearly 48% of Tamil Nadu's annual rainfall is attributed to the retreating monsoon, with Chennai being a significant beneficiary.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Southwest vs. Northeast Monsoon:**

 
 
• The Southwest Monsoon (June-September) brings rainfall to most parts of India, while the Northeast Monsoon (October-December) predominantly affects Tamil Nadu, coastal Andhra Pradesh, and parts of Kerala and Karnataka.
 
• The Southwest Monsoon is driven by southwesterly winds, whereas the Northeast Monsoon is powered by northeasterly winds.
 
 
 
• **Role of Bay of Bengal:**
 
 
• The Bay of Bengal plays a critical role during the retreating monsoon, as cyclonic storms often form here, intensifying rainfall along the southeastern coast of India.
 
• Chennai frequently experiences heavy downpours due to depressions or cyclones originating in the Bay of Bengal.
 
 
 
• **Climate of Tamil Nadu:**
 
 
• Tamil Nadu has a tropical climate, and the retreating monsoon is vital for agriculture, water resources, and drinking water supply in the region.
 
• The state's dependency on the Northeast Monsoon makes it unique compared to other Indian states.
 
 
 
• **Terminology:**
 
 
• Retreating Monsoon: The period when monsoon winds retreat southward, starting from northern India and moving towards the Bay of Bengal.
 
• Northeast Monsoon: Another term for the retreating monsoon, specifically referring to the rainfall caused by northeasterly winds.
